verdict.rationale: Community Phone is a consumer and business phone service with a companion app and online dashboard, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents porting, plans, spam blocking and app features, but nothing about telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking controls, or any way to opt out of them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
